title_zh: 群发邮件吐槽意外变好事
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (10/20): A Reply-All Rant That Turned Out for the Best
note_en: 吐槽 (tǔcáo) is everyday slang for "complaining" or "venting" in a half-joking way: 想顺便跟好友美美吐槽一下加班的事 "she wanted to vent to her friend Meimei about the overtime." Note the structure 跟 someone 吐槽 something: the person you vent to is introduced with 跟 before the verb, where English uses "to" after it. Adding 一下 makes it sound casual, like "have a quick rant."
